scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle:unsigned: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease -PallowUnsignedRelease
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:release:keychain: JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH OLIVE_UPLOAD_KEYSTORE=olive-remote-upload.jks OLIVE_UPLOAD_KEY_ALIAS=olive-upload OLIVE_UPLOAD_STORE_PASSWORD="$(security find-generic-password -a olive-remote -s com.djfracking.oliveremotelab.play-upload -w)" OLIVE_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD="$(security find-generic-password -a olive-remote -s com.djfracking.oliveremotelab.play-upload -w)" npm run android:release
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:archive: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath ios/output/OliveRemote-1.0.4-10.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY='' archive
